purpose: Focused pre-recruitment recalibration after excluding prompt 1 -> 2 from confirmatory autoregressive lags.

estimator.primary_prediction: couple-clustered participant RMSE difference on days 12-14 with t-based confidence intervals across couples
estimator.note: Random intercept and slope heterogeneity is generated but is not parameterized as a required random-effects distribution in the primary GEE.

missingness.note: missingness_strength=0 gives non-informative prompt nonresponse conditional on person response propensity; 1 applies the full state/action-dependent mechanism.

notes: Relational fixed effects are action-scale points per 10-point within-person change in the corresponding closeness variable.
candidate_sesoi_beta values are action-scale points per 10-point within-person relational change; they are calibration candidates, not locked human-effect thresholds.
Truth scenarios are design-sensitivity values, not human ARC effect estimates.
Prompt schedules use six equal strata across the 14-hour window and enforce at least 90 minutes between scheduled prompts.
Observed prompts receive a simulated response latency within the locked 30-minute response window; confirmatory lags use actual response-to-response intervals of 1-4 hours.
Person means used for holdout predictors are estimated from observed days 1-11 prompts only to avoid temporal leakage.
Heavy full-factorial Monte Carlo is intentionally excluded from ordinary CI.

Decision-analysis data sufficiency is configuration-driven: at least minimum_people_with_valid_lags people must meet the valid-lag requirement and each predictive comparison must include at least minimum_prediction_couples dyads.
Post-Monte-Carlo revision: the M1-first sequential RMSE gate is retained only as a historical design-development diagnostic and is not the primary H1 inference rule.

Focused 8,000-replication N=84 asymmetry validation completed: candidate delta_asym values 0.25/0.5/0.75 all failed prespecified operating-characteristic guardrails, so M4 asymmetry is secondary/descriptive only.
Primary autoregressive transitions exclude prompt 1 -> 2; only 2->3, 3->4, 4->5, and 5->6 are eligible because the source action must summarize a standardized preceding same-day ESM interval.

The completed 120,000-replication calibration used the broader adjacent-lag definition; after excluding prompt 1 -> 2, sample-size/data-sufficiency operating characteristics must be recalibrated before recruitment is frozen.

execution.note: Windows FULL preserves deterministic 10-replication chunk identities for resumability, but computes every replication in a fresh Python process. Automatic concurrency is capped at four workers and at most 25% of logical CPUs, with a conservative free-memory guard. Each isolated replication has bounded retries; strict merge rejects overlapping or missing replication keys. Worker processes suppress modal Windows crash dialogs.

ipw_sensitivity.status: prespecified sensitivity; final truncation choice pending targeted Monte Carlo
ipw_sensitivity.assumption: history-based MAR conditional on the denominator response model; not a correction guarantee for contemporaneous unobserved-state MNAR
diagnostics: maximum stabilized lag weight after truncation
weighted versus primary holdout RMSE difference
ipw_sensitivity.covariance_note: statsmodels 0.15.0 observation weights are incompatible with its bias-reduced covariance path in the pinned implementation; weighted finite-cluster coverage is therefore evaluated explicitly in targeted Monte Carlo

final_design.multiplicity: Holm family-wise alpha 0.05 across the two co-primary one-sided SESOI tests
primary_tests: H1-P1: one-sided Wald test H0: M2 beta_r_star <= 0.5 versus beta_r_star > 0.5
H1-P2: one-sided Wald test H0: M3 beta_e <= 0.5 versus beta_e > 0.5
final_design.rmse_role: secondary predictive evidence; no sequential gating
final_design.asymmetry_tolerance_status: not used; focused N=84 validation rejected all prespecified confirmatory tolerance candidates
final_design.asymmetry_reporting: report beta_positive, beta_negative, d_asym, and 95% CI without confirmatory threshold classification
final_design.analysis_target_couples_status: not frozen; select prospectively from recalibration guardrails

recalibration_guardrails.rule: Select the smallest candidate N satisfying every guardrail using the prespecified Monte Carlo confidence bounds. If none qualifies, do not freeze recruitment N.
recalibration_guardrails.uncertainty_rule: For minimum-rate guardrails require the Wilson lower confidence bound to meet the threshold; for maximum-rate guardrails require the Wilson upper confidence bound to meet the threshold. A point estimate that passes while its bound does not is inconclusive and cannot freeze N.
